title: PRISM Pipeline Frontmatter Schema (COMMAND-KERNEL-MS0 / U-CK12)
description: Canonical YAML frontmatter for pipeline entries under knowledge/wiki/os/pipelines/*.md. Each entry registers one automation chain — the schema is the kernel's contract for the U-CK13 pipeline executor + U-CK14 pipeline_integrations wiring + U-CK25 /pipeline meta-command. Adopts the ACP-MS0A automation-chain shape; ACP-MS0A is `not_started` at U-CK12 claim time, so this schema BUILDS the contract and is contributed back to ACP-MS1 (see knowledge/wiki/os/pipelines/_schema.md §contribution-back).

title.description: Human-readable pipeline name shown in wiki UIs (e.g. 'PRISM pipeline — /loop autonomous iteration').

slug.description: Stable pipeline id — kebab-case, optional one-level namespace (e.g. `forge:audit`). Matches the filename (loop.md → slug:loop). Becomes the chain-id in the U-CK13 executor + the key in event-to-chain / command-to-chain mappings.

kind.description: Discriminator — must be the literal string 'pipeline'. Distinguishes pipeline entries from other wiki/os/ artifact types (commands, processes, syscalls, sessions). Uses `enum: [...]` rather than `const:` because the CK06-derived validator subset does not implement `const` (P0 fix from U-CK12 Arm-B scrutiny).

status.description: Lifecycle stage. `shipped` = production-wired and load-bearing; `draft` = documented but not wired; `experimental` = wired behind a knob; `deprecated` = scheduled for removal (must carry `replacement` if soft-deprecation).

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was authored or last materially revised. Pairs with `status` to detect rot — a `shipped` entry whose `date` predates the last load-bearing commit to its `composed_of` surfaces is a regen candidate.

milestone.description: Roadmap milestone this pipeline ships under (e.g. 'COMMAND-KERNEL-MS0'). Cross-referenced by build-milestone-progress.mjs to surface envelope-vs-disk drift.

unit.description: Unit id(s) that shipped this entry (e.g. 'U-CK04-extension' or 'U-KIP01 + U-KIP02').

author.description: Authoring chat / slot (e.g. 'claude-41db1b82 (slot india)'). Diagnostic only; not load-bearing for execution.

oneOf.description: Shorthand trigger kind when the pipeline fires by a single mechanism.

events.description: Hook events that fire the pipeline (when kind=hook).

command.description: Slash-command that fires the pipeline (when kind=command).

trigger.description: How the pipeline is initiated. ACP-MS0A P0-U02 — event-to-chain + command-to-chain mappings.

composed_of.description: Ordered list of stages / commands / engines this pipeline orchestrates. Canonical field name. Backward-compat alias: `composes` (see x-aliases). ACP-MS0A P0-U01 — the `steps` array.

composes.description: DEPRECATED alias for `composed_of` (admitted for back-compat with the 3 seed entries authored before U-CK12). New entries SHOULD use `composed_of`. Both fields validate equivalently; presence of either satisfies the steps requirement.

stages.description: Optional named stage labels (e.g. ['extract','route','plan','inject']). Where `composed_of` lists the TOOLS, `stages` lists the LOGICAL PHASES — both may be present for richer entries.

tier.description: ACP-MS0A P0-U05 tier name. entry-router < 500 tokens; coding < 2000; product-autopilot < 5000; custom uses the explicit max_tokens.

max_tokens.description: Hard ceiling on token spend per fire. Defaults derived from tier when omitted.

enforcement.description: What happens when the budget is exceeded. `hard-stop` aborts the chain; `downgrade-model` switches to a smaller model and continues; `soft-warn` logs only.

token_budget.description: ACP-MS0A P0-U05 — per-chain token budget + enforcement contract.

mode.description: ACP-MS0A P0-U03 — chain-tier downgrade behavior. silent-degrade = fail-soft + telemetry; user-prompt = AskUserQuestion before fallback; hard-stop = abort.

fallback_to.description: Slug of an alternate pipeline to invoke on degrade (e.g. a simpler version of the same chain).

ledger.description: Path to the JSONL ledger this pipeline appends to (e.g. 'state/shared/pipeline-telemetry.jsonl'). Read by U-CK27 adaptive-thresholds.

fields.description: ACP-MS0A P0-U04 — fields emitted per telemetry event. fire_ts + chain_id + outcome are the floor.

telemetry.description: ACP-MS0A P0-U04 — telemetry event schema for this pipeline's fires.

consumes.description: Upstream inputs (file paths, dispatcher actions, other pipelines). Mirrors the command-frontmatter `consumes` field — same shape, different namespace.

produces.description: Outputs written (file paths, dispatcher actions, persistent state). Mirrors command-frontmatter `produces`.

replacement.description: Slug of the replacement pipeline (only when status='deprecated').

acp_ms0a_coverage.P0-U01: composed_of / composes / stages (chain steps) + slug (chain-id) + trigger (triggers) + token_budget (token-budget)

x-rationale.contribution_back: ACP-MS0A is `not_started` at U-CK12 claim time. This schema is the EXTEND-path build per the unit's disposition_conditional; it should be adopted verbatim by ACP-MS1 (or the schema MAY be promoted to ACP-MS0A P0 when that milestone reopens). See knowledge/wiki/os/pipelines/_schema.md §contribution-back.
x-rationale.no_steps_required: composed_of / composes / stages are ALL optional at the root — this is INTENTIONAL. A pipeline MAY register without any orchestration list when the work lives entirely in an external trigger (e.g. a hook-only pipeline whose body runs inside a single .mjs hook script). The U-CK12 validator (scripts/validate-pipeline-registry.mjs) emits a WARNING on entries with no composed_of+composes+stages — schema-level enforcement would require `anyOf` (not implemented by the CK06 validator subset) and would break the back-compat alias path. The U-CK13 pipeline executor enforces step-presence at runtime when the trigger expects orchestration.
x-rationale.validator_subset_limits: The CK06 validator subset cannot enforce: const (use enum-of-one), anyOf, allOf, if/then/else, dependentSchemas, dependentRequired, $ref. Semantic constraints (tier↔max_tokens, deprecated↔replacement, trigger.kind↔payload-shape, at-least-one-steps-field) are documented in prose and enforced by the U-CK13 runtime executor + the validator script's warning layer.
